integrity: All finite counts are reproduced by `verify.py` using two independent witness tests and complete orbit reconstruction. No independent audit has been performed.
limitations: The argument is an exact finite classification only for \(n=4\); it does not prove the general conjecture. Full direct manuscript inspection of arXiv:2606.18234 was unavailable, leaving a residual risk of an unindexed internal small-case computation.
title: Exact evaluation of \(s_1(4)\) and the eight-term extremals
